tree.heading: Authority.—
tree.text: The Secretary may provide a program of vocational training to an eligible child if the Secretary determines that the achievement of a vocational goal by the child is reasonably feasible.

tree.heading: Applicable Provisions.—
tree.text: Subsections (b) through (e) of section 1804 of this title shall apply with respect to any program of vocational training provided under subsection (a).
